title: Ithbank
summary: Use as 1 Camp Supply, drink to gain Alcohol, or throw to leave a flammable surface.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume the bottle to gain Alcohol for 2 turns, imposing disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.
fields.Throw: Action. Break the bottle to create a permanent 13 ft radius Alcohol surface. Fire ignites the spill and Cold freezes it.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
